title: Mizoram PSC Recruitment 2026 – Junior Accounts Officer (JAO), Warden Posts
shortInfo: Mizoram PSC has announced notification for Junior Accounts Officer (JAO), Warden posts. Required qualification: Any Graduate, Any Bachelors Degree. Last date to apply: 21-09-26.
howToApply: Visit the Mizoram Public Service Commission’s official online portal: https://mpsconline.mizoram.gov.in
Register in the One-Time Registration (OTR) portal if not already registered.
Fill in the application form with accurate details.
Mandatorily exercise/make option in the post preference box in the application portal.

Upload all mandatory documents: Marksheets of HSLC & above, Educational Certificates of HSLC & above, Proof of Computer Proficiency, Proof of Mizo Language Proficiency, SC/ST Certificate (if applicable), Proof of date of birth, Proof of educational qualifications.
Pay the application fee (Persons with disabilities are exempted). If paying via UPI, use only the mobile number used for one-time registration.
Verify that the application is actually submitted after payment is made.
Submit the application before 21st September 2026 up to 4:00 PM.

dates.event: Last Date for Submission of Application & Payment of Fees (Extended Upto)

howToApply: Visit Bank’s official website www.bankofbaroda.bank.in under Career section → Current Opportunities.
Register online in the appropriate Online Application Format available through the link on the Careers → Current Opportunities page.
Upload scanned photograph, signature, bio-data, and other required documents as per specifications.
Carefully fill in all details in the online application form. No changes are permitted after clicking SUBMIT.
Pay the application fee online using Debit Card / Credit Card / Internet Banking / UPI etc.
On successful payment, an e-receipt and application form will be generated — print and retain for future reference.
Note down the acknowledgement number and keep a copy of the application form for future reference.
Download call letters from the Bank’s website under Career section → Current Opportunities using registration details and password.
